## Description

Increase equity exposure around month-end and early-month trading days based on a calendar rule.

## Where it may fit

Markets where month-end flows or institutional rebalancing create repeatable demand patterns.

## Vehicles

Equity-index ETF overlays, tactical portfolios.

## Required data

Index/ETF prices, exchange calendar, dividends, funding and execution costs.

## Caveats

A simple calendar pattern may decay and can be hidden by costs or changing market structure.
